record.dic_text:
05031 n@biy'ah {neb-ee-yaw'}

源自 05030; TWOT - 1277c; 陰性名詞

欽定本 - prophetess 6; 6

1) 女預言家
   1a) 古代有歌曲恩賜的,如米利暗
   1b) 後來請益於她們的話語,如戶勒大
   1c) 假女先知挪底亞 (#尼 6:14|)
   1d) 預言家以賽亞的妻子

05031 n@biy'ah {neb-ee-yaw'}

from 05030; TWOT - 1277c; n f

AV - prophetess 6; 6

1) prophetess
   1a) ancient type endowed with gift of song (Miriam)
   1b) later type consulted for a word (Huldah)
   1c) false prophetess (Noadiah)
   1d) wife of Isaiah the prophet
